name: Nuclecard
storyline: Survive a card based nuclear post-apocalyptic world. Build, craft, hunt, and fight through brutal seasons and deadly encounters—all while battling relentless radiation. Test your skills in 9 action-packed mini-games. There is no mercy for the unprepared.
summary:
Nuclecard is a post-apocalyptic survival card game where every decision matters. Build your base across 30+ unique locations, craft 50+ items, cook 35+ foods, and master essential survival skills like farming, hunting, and water purification.
The real challenge comes from the world itself. Radiation zones demand careful navigation, brutal winters punish the unprepared, and 30+ random events trigger 9 action-packed mini-games: flee from wolves, defend against raiders, escape collapsing ruins, stop tank assaults, extinguish forest fires, and more. These aren't optional—event cards force you into real-time survival challenges that disrupt your plans.
With 200+ collectible cards and unpredictable encounters, no two runs play the same. The hand-drawn art style makes the apocalypse surprisingly approachable while keeping the tension high.
